notes: I replaced the fixed-frequency single sine with a chirped oscillation whose frequency is high near the origin (period ~0.4) and drops toward ~2 at larger |x|, matching E15/E16 (fast near-origin structure) and E11/E13 (slow ~2-period at moderate magnitudes). I also made the phase depend on the sign of x to capture the observed asymmetry/jump at zero [E16, E8-E10].
